sentences.text: Respondents  Coram: Hon'ble Ms. Justice Ritu Bahri  1.To be referred to the Reporters or not?
2. Whether the judgment should be reported in the Digest?

Present: Mr. Hitesh Pandit, Advocate  for the petitioner/s.
 Ms. Anu Pal, AAG, Punjab.
Counsel for the petitioner states that now the Tribunal has been constituted under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standard Act 2006 which is being headed by a District Judge,
The petitioner is relegated to file an appeal against the order dated 21.8.2012 (Annexure P-5) before the said Tribunal and the Tribunal shall consider his prayer for condonation of delay.
